explanation: The value is 0 at every D1 and GO step and is non-zero only at D2, where it peaks (9-10) when the agent chose a1, landed rarely in S2, and the previous trial was unrewarded. If that a1-to-S2 rare transition comes right after a rewarded trial it is only about 2-5 (0 inside a long run of rewards), a common a1-to-S1 D2 after an unrewarded trial gives about 2, and everything else, including nearly all a2 trials, is 0-1.
